sources.title: Madushanka stars as Sri Lanka thrash Pakistan to end England’s tri-series hopes
Madushanka’s five-for powers Sri Lanka into tri-series final after Pakistan drubbing
England eliminated from ODI tri-series as Sri Lanka beat Pakistan
England out of tri-series after Sri Lanka beat Pakistan

en.title: Sri Lanka beat Pakistan to secure tri‑series final spot
en.dek: Sri Lanka won by eight wickets, ending England’s chance to reach the final.
facts: Sri Lanka defeated Pakistan by eight wickets (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Pakistan were all out for 110 runs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Sri Lanka chased 114-2 in 18.1 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Dilshan Madushanka took five wickets for 34 runs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
England were eliminated from the tri‑series (Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC).
body: Sri Lanka won the one‑day international match against Pakistan in Lahore. The Sri Lankan bowlers dismissed Pakistan for 110 runs in 25.3 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Dilshan Madushanka claimed a career‑best five for 34 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

Sri Lanka chased the target of 111 runs in 18.1 overs, finishing with 114-2 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Kamindu Mendis scored an unbeaten 62 off 60 balls (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). The win secured Sri Lanka’s place in the final against Pakistan on 31 October (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

England had lost all three of their matches in the tri‑series (Sky Sports, BBC). They needed Pakistan to beat Sri Lanka to keep a chance of reaching the final (Sky Sports, BBC). Pakistan’s loss meant England’s hopes were ended (Sky Sports, BBC).
Pakistan had already qualified for the final after beating England twice (Guardian, Dawn). They had previously beaten Sri Lanka by 37 runs in the opening game (Guardian).
The final will be played on 31 October between Sri Lanka and Pakistan (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Sri Lanka will also play England in a dead‑rubber match on Thursday (Guardian, BBC).
en.context: The tri‑series is a 50‑over competition featuring Sri Lanka, Pakistan, and England. England lost all three of their matches. The outcome of the Pakistan‑Sri Lanka match determined the final lineup.

de.title: Sri Lanka besiegt Pakistan und sichert sich den Platz im Tri‑Series-Finale
de.dek: Sri Lanka gewann mit acht Wickets und beendet damit Englands Chance, das Finale zu erreichen.
facts: Sri Lanka besiegte Pakistan mit acht Wickets (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Pakistan wurde für 110 Läufe ausgeschieden (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Sri Lanka verfolgte 114-2 in 18,1 Overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Dilshan Madushanka erzielte fünf Wickets für 34 Läufe (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
England wurde aus dem Tri‑Series ausgeschieden (Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC).
body: Sri Lanka gewann das Ein‑Tages-International gegen Pakistan in Lahore. Die sri-lankischen Bowlers schlugen Pakistan für 110 Läufe in 25,3 Overs aus (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Dilshan Madushanka erzielte einen Karrierebesten fünf für 34 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

Sri Lanka verfolgte das Ziel von 111 Läufen in 18,1 Overs und endete mit 114-2 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Kamindu Mendis erzielte 62 unverletzt von 60 Bällen (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Der Sieg sicherte Sri Lanka den Platz im Finale gegen Pakistan am 31. Oktober (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

England hatte alle drei ihrer Spiele im Tri‑Series verloren (Sky Sports, BBC). Sie benötigten, dass Pakistan Sri Lanka schlägt, um noch eine Chance auf das Finale zu haben (Sky Sports, BBC). Pakistans Niederlage bedeutete das Ende der Hoffnungen Englands (Sky Sports, BBC).
Pakistan hatte bereits das Finale nach zwei Siegen gegen England qualifiziert (Guardian, Dawn). Sie hatten Sri Lanka bereits im Eröffnungsspiel um 37 Läufe geschlagen (Guardian).
Das Finale findet am 31. Oktober zwischen Sri Lanka und Pakistan statt (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Sri Lanka wird auch ein Endspiel gegen England am Donnerstag spielen (Guardian, BBC).
de.context: Der Tri‑Series ist ein 50‑Über-Wettbewerb mit Sri Lanka, Pakistan und England. England verlor alle drei Spiele. Das Ergebnis des Spiels zwischen Pakistan und Sri Lanka bestimmte die Endaufstellung.

es.title: Sri Lanka vence a Pakistán y asegura su lugar en la final de la tri‑serie
es.dek: Sri Lanka gana por ocho wickets, acabando con la posibilidad de Inglaterra de llegar a la final.
facts: Sri Lanka derrotó a Pakistán por ocho wickets (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Pakistán fue eliminado por 110 carreras (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Sri Lanka alcanzó 114-2 en 18.1 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Dilshan Madushanka tomó cinco wickets por 34 carreras (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Inglaterra fue eliminado de la tri‑serie (Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC).
body: Sri Lanka ganó el partido internacional de un día contra Pakistán en Lahore. Los lanzadores de Sri Lanka eliminaron a Pakistán por 110 carreras en 25.3 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Dilshan Madushanka consiguió su mejor rendimiento de carrera: cinco wickets por 34 carreras (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

Sri Lanka alcanzó el objetivo de 111 carreras en 18.1 overs, terminando con 114-2 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Kamindu Mendis anotó 62 sin perder bate (62 de 60 bolas) (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). La victoria aseguró el lugar de Sri Lanka en la final contra Pakistán el 31 de octubre (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

Inglaterra había perdido los tres partidos de la tri‑serie (Sky Sports, BBC). Necesitaban que Pakistán venciera a Sri Lanka para mantener la posibilidad de llegar a la final (Sky Sports, BBC). La derrota de Pakistán significó el fin de las esperanzas de Inglaterra (Sky Sports, BBC).
Pakistán ya había calificado para la final tras vencer a Inglaterra dos veces (Guardian, Dawn). Anteriormente, habían vencido a Sri Lanka por 37 carreras en el primer partido (Guardian).
La final se jugará el 31 de octubre entre Sri Lanka y Pakistán (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Sri Lanka también jugará contra Inglaterra en un partido sin relevancia el jueves (Guardian, BBC).
es.context: La tri‑serie es una competición de 50 overs que incluye a Sri Lanka, Pakistán e Inglaterra. Inglaterra perdió los tres partidos. El resultado del encuentro entre Pakistán y Sri Lanka determinó la alineación final.

it.title: Sri Lanka batte il Pakistan per assicurarsi il posto in finale della tri-serie
it.dek: Sri Lanka vinse per otto wickets, terminando la possibilità dell'Inghilterra di arrivare in finale.
facts: Sri Lanka ha sconfitto il Pakistan per otto wickets (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Il Pakistan è stato eliminato per 110 run (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Sri Lanka ha raggiunto 114-2 in 18,1 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Dilshan Madushanka ha preso cinque wickets per 34 run (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
L'Inghilterra è stata eliminata dalla tri-serie (Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC).
body: Sri Lanka ha vinto la partita internazionale a un giorno contro il Pakistan a Lahore. I lanciatori sri-lankesi hanno eliminato il Pakistan per 110 run in 25,3 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Dilshan Madushanka ha ottenuto un record personale con cinque wickets per 34 run (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

Sri Lanka ha raggiunto il target di 111 run in 18,1 overs, terminando con 114-2 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Kamindu Mendis ha segnato 62 senza fallimenti su 60 balli (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). La vittoria ha assicurato a Sri Lanka il posto in finale contro il Pakistan il 31 ottobre (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

L'Inghilterra aveva perso tutte e tre le sue partite nella tri-serie (Sky Sports, BBC). Avevano bisogno che il Pakistan battesse Sri Lanka per mantenere una possibilità di arrivare in finale (Sky Sports, BBC). La sconfitta del Pakistan ha terminato le speranze dell'Inghilterra (Sky Sports, BBC).

Il Pakistan si era già qualificato per la finale dopo aver battuto l'Inghilterra due volte (Guardian, Dawn). Avevano precedentemente sconfitto Sri Lanka per 37 run nella partita di apertura (Guardian).
La finale si giocherà il 31 ottobre tra Sri Lanka e Pakistan (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Sri Lanka giocherà anche contro l'Inghilterra in una partita a vuoto giovedì (Guardian, BBC).
it.context: La tri-serie è una competizione a 50 overs che vede in campo Sri Lanka, Pakistan e Inghilterra. L'Inghilterra ha perso tutte e tre le partite. L'esito della partita Pakistan‑Sri Lanka ha determinato la finale.

fr.title: Sri Lanka bat Pakistan pour sécuriser une place en finale de la tri‑série
fr.dek: Sri Lanka a gagné par huit wickets, mettant fin à la chance de l'Angleterre d'atteindre la finale.
facts: Sri Lanka a battu le Pakistan par huit wickets (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Le Pakistan a été éliminé pour 110 runs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Sri Lanka a poursuivi 114-2 en 18,1 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Dilshan Madushanka a pris cinq wickets pour 34 runs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
L'Angleterre a été éliminée de la tri‑série (Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC).
body: Sri Lanka a remporté le match international à un jour contre le Pakistan à Lahore. Les lanceurs sri-lankais ont éliminé le Pakistan pour 110 runs en 25,3 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Dilshan Madushanka a enregistré son meilleur exploit de carrière, cinq wickets pour 34 runs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

Sri Lanka a poursuivi l'objectif de 111 runs en 18,1 overs, terminant avec 114-2 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Kamindu Mendis a marqué 62 sans être éliminé sur 60 balles (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). La victoire a assuré la place de Sri Lanka en finale contre le Pakistan le 31 octobre (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

L'Angleterre avait perdu ses trois matchs dans la tri‑série (Sky Sports, BBC). Elle avait besoin que le Pakistan batte Sri Lanka pour garder une chance d'atteindre la finale (Sky Sports, BBC). La défaite du Pakistan a mis fin aux espoirs de l'Angleterre (Sky Sports, BBC).
Le Pakistan était déjà qualifié pour la finale après avoir battu l'Angleterre deux fois (Guardian, Dawn). Il avait déjà battu Sri Lanka par 37 runs lors du premier match (Guardian).
La finale se jouera le 31 octobre entre Sri Lanka et Pakistan (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Sri Lanka jouera également l'Angleterre dans un match sans enjeu le jeudi (Guardian, BBC).
fr.context: La tri‑série est une compétition de 50 overs réunissant Sri Lanka, Pakistan et Angleterre. L'Angleterre a perdu ses trois matchs. Le résultat du match Pakistan‑Sri Lanka a déterminé la composition finale.

pt.title: Sri Lanka vence Paquistão e garante lugar na final da tri‑série
pt.dek: Sri Lanka venceu por oito wickets, encerrando a possibilidade da Inglaterra de chegar à final.
facts: Sri Lanka derrotou o Paquistão por oito wickets (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
O Paquistão foi eliminado com 110 corridas (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Sri Lanka perseguiu 114-2 em 18.1 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
Dilshan Madushanka tirou cinco wickets por 34 corridas (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
A Inglaterra foi eliminada da tri‑série (Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC).
body: Sri Lanka venceu o jogo internacional de dia único contra o Paquistão em Lahore. Os arremessadores sri-lankeses eliminaram o Paquistão com 110 corridas em 25.3 overs (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Dilshan Madushanka registou o melhor da carreira, tirando cinco wickets por 34 corridas (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

Sri Lanka perseguiu o alvo de 111 corridas em 18.1 overs, terminando com 114-2 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). Kamindu Mendis marcou 62 sem perder um wicket a partir de 60 bolas (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). A vitória garantiu o lugar do Sri Lanka na final contra o Paquistão em 31 de outubro (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

A Inglaterra havia perdido os três jogos na tri‑série (Sky Sports, BBC). Precisavam que o Paquistão vencesse o Sri Lanka para manter a possibilidade de chegar à final (Sky Sports, BBC). A derrota do Paquistão significou o fim das esperanças da Inglaterra (Sky Sports, BBC).
O Paquistão já tinha qualificado para a final depois de vencer a Inglaterra duas vezes (Guardian, Dawn). Anteriormente, havia derrotado o Sri Lanka por 37 corridas no jogo inaugural (Guardian).

A final será disputada em 31 de outubro entre Sri Lanka e Paquistão (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). O Sri Lanka também enfrentará a Inglaterra num jogo de desempate na quinta‑feira (Guardian, BBC).
pt.context: A tri‑série é uma competição de 50 overs que reúne Sri Lanka, Paquistão e Inglaterra. A Inglaterra perdeu os três jogos. O resultado do confronto Paquistão‑Sri Lanka determinou a composição da final.

zh.title: 斯里兰卡击败巴基斯坦，锁定三国赛决赛席位
zh.dek: 斯里兰卡以八柱优势获胜，终结英格兰晋级决赛的希望
facts: 斯里兰卡以八柱优势击败巴基斯坦（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）
巴基斯坦被全队击败，仅得110分（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）
斯里兰卡在18.1局内完成114-2的追赶（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）
Dilshan Madushanka以34分5镖的最佳表现（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）
英格兰被淘汰出三国赛（《卫报》、Sky Sports、BBC）
body: 斯里兰卡在拉合尔赢得了一场一日国际赛，对手巴基斯坦被全队击败，仅得110分，耗时25.3局（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）。Dilshan Madushanka以34分5镖的职业最佳表现（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）。
斯里兰卡在18.1局内完成111分的追赶，最终114-2（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）。Kamindu Mendis以60球不失分的62分领衔（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）。这场胜利确保斯里兰卡将于10月31日对阵巴基斯坦进入决赛（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）。
英格兰在三国赛中三场失利（Sky Sports、BBC）。他们需要巴基斯坦击败斯里兰卡，才能保留晋级决赛的机会（Sky Sports、BBC）。巴基斯坦的失利意味着英格兰的希望破灭（Sky Sports、BBC）。
巴基斯坦在击败英格兰两次后已锁定决赛席位（《卫报》、Dawn）。他们在开局比赛中曾以37分击败斯里兰卡（《卫报》）。
决赛将于10月31日举行，参赛双方为斯里兰卡和巴基斯坦（《卫报》、Dawn、Sky Sports、BBC）。斯里兰卡还将在周四与英格兰进行一场无关紧要的比赛（《卫报》、BBC）。
zh.context: 三国赛是一项50局制比赛，参赛方为斯里兰卡、巴基斯坦和英格兰。英格兰三场失利。巴基斯坦与斯里兰卡的比赛结果决定了决赛阵容。

ja.title: スリランカがパキスタンを破りトリシリーズ決勝進出を確保
ja.dek: スリランカは8ウィケットで勝利し、イングランドの決勝進出のチャンスを終わらせた。
facts: スリランカはパキスタンを8ウィケットで破った（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。
パキスタンは110ランで全敗（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。
スリランカは18.1オーバーで114-2を追いかけた（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。
ディルシャン・マドゥシャンカは34ランで5ウィケットを取った（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。
イングランドはトリシリーズから降格された（Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC）。
body: スリランカはラホールでパキスタンに対して1日インターナショナルマッチで勝利した。スリランカのボウラーは25.3オーバーでパキスタンを110ランで全敗させた（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。ディルシャン・マドゥシャンカはキャリア最高の5ウィケットを34ランで取った（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。

スリランカは18.1オーバーで111ランのターゲットを追い、114-2で終了した（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。カミンドゥ・メンディスは60ボールで62ランを未出場でスコアした（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。この勝利でスリランカは10月31日にパキスタンとの決勝戦に進出した（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。
イングランドはトリシリーズで3試合すべて敗北していた（Sky Sports, BBC）。彼らはパキスタンがスリランカに勝つことを望んでいた（Sky Sports, BBC）。パキスタンの敗北でイングランドの希望は終わった（Sky Sports, BBC）。
パキスタンはイングランドを2度破ってすでに決勝に進出していた（Guardian, Dawn）。彼らはオープニングゲームでスリランカを37ランで破った（Guardian）。
決勝戦は10月31日にスリランカ対パキスタンで行われる（Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC）。スリランカは木曜日にイングランドとデッドラバー試合を行う（Guardian, BBC）。
ja.context: トリシリーズは50オーバーの競技で、スリランカ、パキスタン、イングランドが参加する。イングランドは3試合すべて敗北した。パキスタン対スリランカの試合結果が決勝ラインアップを決定した。

ko.title: 스리랑카, 파키스탄을 이겨 트리시리즈 결승 진출 확보
ko.dek: 스리랑카가 8개 탈락으로 승리해 잉글랜드의 결승 진출 기회를 종결시켰다.
facts: 스리랑카가 파키스탄을 8개 탈락으로 이겼다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
파키스탄은 110점에 전멸했다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
스리랑카는 18.1오버에 114-2를 달성했다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
딜샨 마두샹카가 34점에 5개 탈락을 기록했다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
잉글랜드는 트리시리즈에서 탈락했다 (Guardian, Sky Sports, BBC).
body: 스리랑카는 라호르에서 파키스탄과의 1일 국제 경기를 승리했다. 스리랑카 투수들은 25.3오버에 파키스탄을 110점에 전멸시켰다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). 딜샨 마두샹카는 34점에 5개 탈락을 기록하며 개인 최고를 달성했다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).

스리랑카는 18.1오버에 111점을 추격해 114-2로 마무리했다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). 카민두 멘디스는 60볼에 62점을 무패로 기록했다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). 이 승리는 10월 31일 파키스탄과의 결승 진출을 확정했다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC).
잉글랜드는 트리시리즈에서 세 경기 모두 패배했다 (Sky Sports, BBC). 그들은 파키스탄이 스리랑카를 이겨 결승 진출 기회를 유지하길 원했다 (Sky Sports, BBC). 파키스탄의 패배는 잉글랜드의 희망을 종결시켰다 (Sky Sports, BBC).
파키스탄은 잉글랜드를 두 번 이겨 이미 결승 진출을 확정했다 (Guardian, Dawn). 그들은 이전 경기에서 스리랑카를 37점 차로 이겼다 (Guardian).
결승은 10월 31일 스리랑카와 파키스탄 간에 진행된다 (Guardian, Dawn, Sky Sports, BBC). 스리랑카는 목요일에 잉글랜드와의 무승부 경기도 진행한다 (Guardian, BBC).
ko.context: 트리시리즈는 스리랑카, 파키스탄, 잉글랜드가 참가하는 50오버 경기이며, 잉글랜드는 세 경기 모두 패배했다. 파키스탄-스리랑카 경기 결과가 결승 진출 명단을 결정했다.

problemsFixed: Paragraph 4 incorrectly states Pakistan lost to Sri Lanka by 37 runs in the opening game; the Guardian says Pakistan handed Sri Lanka a 37-run defeat (meaning Pakistan won).
Context incorrectly states England won two matches and lost one; Sky Sports and BBC report England lost all three matches.
